title: Contingency Plan for Excessive Heat Emergencies - California, United States of America
organization: California Governor’s Office of Emergency Services (OES)
landscapes: Urban, Rural, Household, Institutional, Occupational, Arid
description: This statewide excessive heat contingency plan supports the California State Emergency Plan and outlines state actions to support local governments before and during excessive heat events. It includes Seasonal Readiness, Heat Alert, and Heat Emergency phases; state and local coordination; public information; cooling centers; direct contact and monitoring of at-risk people; transportation to cooling centers; emergency proclamation procedures; local government checklists; vulnerable population guidance; and recovery operations.
